reference:
The phrase "The Guards, The Elite" was coined by Field Marshal K. M. Cariappa, who raised the Brigade of The Guards, which included the conversion of the 2nd battalion 2nd Punjab Regiment, 1st battalion Indian Grenadiers Regiment, and 1st battalion 6th Rajputana Rifles into Guards battalions in 1949. 

FINDING: The 2nd battalion 2nd Punjab Regiment was one of the battalions converted into Guards battalions in 1949.
